    <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;">Exhibit 99.1&nbsp;</p>
    <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;"><b>For Release July 1, 2026&nbsp;</b>&nbsp;</p>
    <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;">Contact: Casey Reese&nbsp;</p>
    <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;">615-571-2992 |&nbsp;<u>media@nhccare.com&nbsp;</u>&nbsp;</p>
    <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>
    <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:center;"><b>NHC COMPLETES ACQUISITION OF THIRTY-FIVE NHI FACILITIES</b>
    </p>
    <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>
    <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><b>MURFREESBORO, TN. (July 1, 2026)</b> &#8211; National Healthcare Corporation (NYSE American: NHC), a national leader in senior care, announced today that it has completed the acquisition of the real estate of thirty-two skilled nursing facilities and three independent living facilities from National Health Investors, Inc. and its affiliates (&#8220;NHI&#8221;) for a $560 million purchase price. NHC, through affiliates, had been leasing and operating these facilities under a Master Agreement to Lease with NHI originally entered into in 1991.</p>
    <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>
    <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&#8220;We are confident that owning these healthcare centers &#8211; versus leasing &#8211; will yield strong, long-term returns for our investors and is expected to be accretive to earnings and cash flow. Securing ownership of these important assets was an important aspect of our operational strategy and vision for NHC,&#8221; said Steve Flatt, Chief Executive Officer of NHC.</p>
    <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>
    <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">The real estate where these facilities are located is in Alabama, Florida, Kentucky, Missouri, South Carolina, Tennessee, and Virginia. NHC currently operates and will continue to operate all of these facilities, except four Florida skilled nursing facilities. The four Florida skilled nursing facilities will continue to be subject to a third-party operator&#8217;s lease. NHC operates multiple skilled nursing facilities, assisted living and independent living communities, as well as homecare and hospice agencies within this geographic footprint. The acquisition complements NHC&#8217;s current asset portfolio within these regions.</p>
    <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>
    <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&#8220;Continuing to provide exceptional patient care in these communities is a central priority, and acquiring this real estate ensures we have the operational control to achieve that objective. Since we were already operating and offering many health care service lines, including assisted living, homecare, hospice, and behavioral health, within this geographic footprint, the acquisition also enhances and complements that continuum of care,&#8221; Dr. Flatt continued.</p>
    <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>
    <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;margin-top:0;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;"><b>About National HealthCare Corporation</b>&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
    <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;margin-top:0;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;">NHC affiliates operate for themselves and third parties 80 skilled nursing facilities with 10,323 beds. NHC affiliates also operate 26 assisted living communities with 1,413 units, nine independent living communities with 775 units, three behavioral health hospitals, 34 homecare agencies, and 33 hospice agencies. NHC&#8217;s other services include Alzheimer&#8217;s and memory care units, pharmacy services, a rehabilitation services company, and providing management and accounting services to third party post-acute operators. Other information about the company can be found on our website at www.nhccare.com.</p>
    <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>
    <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;margin-top:0;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;"><b>Forward-Looking Statements</b>
    </p>
    <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;margin-top:0;text-align:justify;text-indent:0pt;">Statements in this press release that are not historical facts are &#8220;forward-looking statements&#8221; as that term is defined by the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995.
